S2.name: generated:S2
S2.description:
Operator (non-supervisor) is refused a release and the refusal is recorded

risk: authorization (priority P0)
purpose: Put a non-supervisor actor at the release endpoint and confirm it is refused, no release lands, and the denial is written to the audit log.
requirement: a non-supervisor is refused and no release occurs
product principle: authority_clarity
rationale: This is the core control: a non-supervisor must never release, and the denial must be evidence, not a silent 403.

S3.name: generated:S3
S3.description:
Supervisor of tenant A cannot release tenant B's operation

risk: cross_tenant (priority P0)
purpose: A supervisor authenticated for tenant A targets an operation owned by tenant B; confirm it is refused, no release occurs, and the cross-tenant denial is recorded.
requirement: a supervisor of one tenant cannot release another tenant's operation
product principle: authority_clarity
rationale: Role alone is not authority: a supervisor's power is scoped to their tenant, and the store is tenant-first precisely so B's row cannot be spelled by A.

generated at 2026-08-10T06:30:25+00:00 (stage=initial, wave 1)
because of risk: Release scopes by role but reads the operation using the caller-supplied tenant, so A's supervisor reaches B's operation.

S6.name: generated:S6
S6.description:
Concurrent supervisor and operator releases on one operation — single releaser wins

risk: concurrency (priority P1)
purpose: Fire a supervisor release and a non-supervisor release simultaneously at the same operation; confirm at most one release lands and the operator's attempt is refused and recorded.

product principle: authority_clarity
rationale: The refusal invariant must survive a race with a legitimate release; a threaded server can otherwise let the loser's effect slip through or double-release.

Refusal survives a callback restart (durable audit)

rationale: 'Every refusal is recorded' is only true if the record is durable; the server documents in-memory per-request state that a restart discards.
